title: Source-driven actor-table reads, disjoint row writes and compiled full-graph checks
scope: All timings are fresh Linux processes. No result/graph cache, symmetry declaration or model-specific edit is used for the original checks. A compiled executable can be reused across source edits.

host.platform: Dedicated c7i.4xlarge, us-east-2b; Intel Xeon Platinum 8488C, 8 physical cores / 16 threads, 32,306,600 KiB RAM; Ubuntu 24.04.5 LTS, Linux 7.0.0-1018-aws
host.affinity: taskset -c 0-7; CPUs 8-15 are sibling threads. Flint 8 workers; Lamport 1.
host.memory: Fresh cgroup v2 per command, peak_bytes is memory.peak for the process and descendants, including charged file pages. wall_s uses CLOCK_MONOTONIC. A peer compilation and its check run inside one cgroup. Preparation and emitted check have separate peaks.
host.compiler: rustc 1.99.0; Core release --locked -p dive-cli --bin dive with CARGO_PROFILE_RELEASE_LTO=off and CARGO_PROFILE_RELEASE_CODEGEN_UNITS=16. Pinned peer used its own cargo build --release --locked defaults.

inputs.Flint: ddalton/flint@8feba0c78f22e3ecdee0648c6b2897eac95ab1b4, lean/formal/LeanP1.tla. Recreate LeanP1Size3L1W3.cfg from lean/formal/LeanP1Holds1p3b.cfg with the substitutions in lean/formal/results/2026-10-06-ec2/scripts/runner3.sh lines 12–18. Each preparation row records both SHA-256 values.
inputs.Examples: tlaplus/Examples@6a7b26a31c1a6aeec789b455e9bbfa3b3ad2728f, specifications/transaction_commit/{TCommit,TwoPhase}, original same-basename TLA+ and CFG files.
inputs.edits: Start at the published small source and CFG, then two unchanged warm runs. Prepend TRUE /\ to Inv_CitationsLive. For growth, also replace barriers < MaxBarriers by barriers <= MaxBarriers in the Consume guard after s \notin Readers /\ w[s].pc = "idle". Revert the guard, then the property. Each run is a new process.

commands.core: dive check MODULE.tla --config CONFIG --workers W --store fp|exact --fp 0 --seed 0 --max-memory 8g --time-limit 120s --output json; Lamport adds --compat=tlc. Set DIVE_CORE_OPT=-actor-rows for same-binary fallback. Every check loads the current module and CFG.
commands.prepare: python3 scripts/perf/scale/native-successors/prepare.py MODULE.tla --config CONFIG --cache PRIVATE_CACHE --jobs 8 --profile dive; then use returned binary for the same check.
commands.peer: TLAMC_CACHE=PRIVATE_CACHE tla-mc -compile -config CONFIG -workers W MODULE.tla. Cold begins with an empty peer cache; warm-growth reuses the preceding growth binary despite working-file edits.
commands.controls: Run stock and actor-rows using both profiles. For negative words append BarrierBound == barriers = 0, NoBarrierStep == [][barriers' = barriers]_vars, or NotPrepared == \A r \in RM : rmState[r] # "prepared", respectively, and append the appropriate INVARIANT/PROPERTY to the CFG. Use exact store, workers 1/8 and --compat=tlc. Pass word to stock dive validate-trace with the same module/CFG; replace the initial state with the final state and repeat.

interpretation.original: Independent reversed-order original checks were 2.94–3.02 s against 3.50–3.55 s stock, or 3.42–3.46 s against 3.99–4.03 s with full equality. The nominal Lamport probes complete in milliseconds and do not establish a material speedup.
interpretation.composition: Emitted search was 2.62–2.63 s warm, plus 0.23–0.24 s to verify binding. Cold build plus search was 43.72 s against 37.06 s for tla-mc. The property-only edit was 2.89 s including preparation versus 22.33 s peer. The 43.72 s growth search plus 0.23 s preparation was essentially level with 43.88 s for the changed peer; the peer finished an already-compiled growth search in 23.75 s. #1314 remains open.
interpretation.memory: The accepted row cache spends memory to avoid repeated actor-record transforms. In the paired original fp controls Core rose from 131–133 MiB to 137–145 MiB (rounded). The measured reductions in arena usage concern temporary handles; process memory need not fall.
interpretation.source: Stock-to-candidate and peer use identical original modules/configs at each stage. The optional worker emits original control flow and still uses the current Core value plan. The available cache changes executable preparation latency; every reported graph is freshly reached.

scalar_row_quantifier_key.design: project pure quantifier predicate memo inputs onto scalar actor rows

outer_table_replacement_cache.design: persistent exact (table, key, new entry) key after ordinary RHS evaluation
outer_table_replacement_cache.disposition: little wall-time gain with higher retention; omitted
outer_table_replacement_cache.cpu_sample: perf record -e cpu-clock -F 511 -- taskset -c 0-7 TRIAL check ... on original; unsampled timings above. Leaf symbols, not disjoint wall phases.

hashed_actor_reads.design: bounded read cache keyed by complete immutable table and scalar key

phase_split.note: separate development runs; external wall and peak process-family measurements are recorded below

validation.review: Independent source and lifetime review, 15 stock/candidate pairs including both comparison profiles, missing keys, exception ordering, actual cache hits and eight forced Store collections. Genuine words independently checked against stock and damaged versions rejected.
validation.ratchet: Core default small tier, examples TCommit/TwoPhase/DieHard, 1 worker, no SANY: 0 regressions against small-core-dive-w1.
validation.focused: dive-core heap differential checks all representation flags, hash/sum and contents for ordinary/nested/lazy replacement and full/delta hashing; dive-api core_primed_memo exercises a 108-state program with unrelated updates and external input; targeted clippy.

transfer_cold_note: The initial actor build is labeled development. The paired_controls section records the reviewed candidate on both Lamport inputs, including exact and fingerprint stores.
